items.title: Micron’s Real Risk: China’s CXMT Targets “20% by 2028,” Warns Dan Niles
items.summary: Key TakeawaysDan Niles says China’s CXMT holds about 8% of the DRAM market and aims for 20% by 2028, the year analysts expect Micron’s highest earnings yet. Micron’s record fiscal 2026 came mostly from higher memory prices, so new Chinese supply threatens the source of its profits.

items.title: Micron Tech Gains as Tech Giants Scramble to Lock in Multiyear Supply
items.summary: Micron Technology Inc. (NASDAQ:MU) stock gained more than 3% on Tuesday as traders moved back into high-beta semiconductor names despite softer index futures. Nasdaq futures gained 0.74%, while S&P 500 futures were up 0.32% at the time of writing. Micron’s relative strength comes after a pullback from its mid-year peak, with investors continuing to weigh tight memory supply and AI-driven demand against the risk that future capacity additions eventually create another oversupply cycle.
